answer: Yes, this is a real bug. Root cause: when a request is preempted in sim/batch_formation.go:preemptForTokens(), ProgressIndex is reset to 0 (line 232) but TotalOutputTokens (incremented per decode step in sim/simulator.go:647) is never adjusted. The preempted request re-enters the wait queue, gets rescheduled, re-prefills, and re-decodes — counting every output token again. The fix: (1) compute the number of output tokens already generated before resetting ProgressIndex, pass this count through the PreemptedRequest struct, and subtract it from TotalOutputTokens when processing preemptions in scheduleBatch(); (2) clear the request's ITL slice on preemption to prevent duplicate inter-token latency entries; (3) reset TTFTSet and deduct FirstTokenTime from TTFTSum to prevent double-counting TTFT.
